en.summary: Adds opt-in native preparation failure audits and a separate bounded Session projection.
en.compatibility: Existing Sessions have no preparation-failure event. The new required event uses the existing Session envelope and committed sequence identity; builds without its event type refuse the log. Preparation audits neither increment dispatch counts nor alter token totals. Its projection begins at state version 1; the existing settlement projection and envelope grammar are unchanged.
en.verification: The 639 affected owner tests pass, with 100% focused coverage of the executable preparation helper and recording/projection modules. Headless and TypeScript SDK cases produce one preparation audit and one later completed settlement, with fixed SDK protocol outputs. Python SDK passes seven cases; the new case consumes retained V3 and requires one preparation record. Omitting only the built audit append fails that fixed assertion, then exact artifact bytes are restored. No real provider account was called.

zh.summary: 增加可选的原生准备失败审计及独立的有界 Session 投影。
zh.compatibility: 既有 Session 没有准备失败事件。新增必读事件沿用 Session 信封和已提交序号身份；不认识该事件类型的构建会拒绝日志。准备审计不增加分发次数或 token 总量。新投影从状态版本 1 开始；既有结算投影与信封语法不变。
zh.verification: 639 项相关拥有者测试通过，准备辅助模块与记录／投影模块的聚焦覆盖率达到 100%。Headless 与 TypeScript SDK 场景产生一条准备审计及一条后续成功结算，并有固定 SDK 协议输出。Python SDK 七项测试通过；新增场景读取保留的 V3 输入并要求一条准备记录。仅移除构建产物的审计追加会触发该固定断言失败，随后恢复完全相同的产物。没有调用真实提供方账户。
